cl.x: Provide Sika® Sigunit® L-530 AF where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (August 2024, Version 01.02).

Sika® Sigunit® L-530 AF is a high-performance liquid, alkali-free, setting and hardening accelerator for shotcrete. Sika® Sigunit® L-530 AF is a solution based product and no circulation is required to keep Sika® Sigunit® L-530 AF homogenised.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.l: Sigunit®L-530 AF is suitable for both dry and wet spraying processes and it is used for:
s: Support at the face, wall & backs whilst advancing tunnels and mines
Rock- and slope stabilisation
High quality lining shotcrete

cl.x: Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.4.

cl.l: Sika® Sigunit® L-530 AF liquid shotcrete set accelerator has the following characteristics and advantages:
s: No circulation required
No waste due to settlement
High early strength development
Alkali-free
Minimal strength loss of the accelerated concrete
No pollution of groundwater by leached out alkalis
Distinct reduction of rebound and dust
Improves bond of shotcrete to rock and concrete thus facilitating overhead spraying
Chloride-free, does not negatively affect the reinforcement steel
Composition: Aqueous solution of selected inorganic materials.
Appearance and colour: Cloudy white liquid
Specific gravity: 1.46 g/cm³
pH-Value: 3.0 approximately
Viscosity: ≤ 120 mPa s at +20°C
r: Aqueous solution of selected inorganic materials.

s: Total chloride ion content: ≤ 0.1%
Equivalent sodium oxide: ≤ 1.0%
Restrictions: If thicker layers of shotcrete are to be applied, ensure that the temperature of the basic concrete is not lower than +15°C. Lower temperatures require higher dosage of accelerator.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Product Information > Compatibility
cl.x: The following Sika® products are generally used for the basic shotcrete mix: Sika® ViscoCrete® product range; SikaTard®-960 HC; SikaMix®; Sika® Stabilizer 4R AU and Sika® Stabilizer-821 CS; Sigunit®L-530 AF is not compatible with alkaline shotcrete accelerators.

s: The substrate must be clean, free of loose stones and free of water under hydrostatic pressure.

The accelerator’s effect depends on the cement content, the age and type of cement, on the substrate and the shotcrete temperature as well as on the layer thickness and spraying process, quality of equipment and application technique. The w/c ratio of the basic concrete mix in the wet spraying process, and the quantity of gauging water in the dry spraying process are also parameters influencing the acceleration effect of Sigunit®L-530 AF.

Before using Sigunit®L-530 AF the accelerator hoses must be cleaned thoroughly. The use of Sigunit®L-530 AF requires technically correct dosing and conveying / spraying technology. Metal parts of the pump that come into direct contact with Sigunit®L-530 AF must be made of stainless steel

cl.x: When using sulphate resistant cements strength development can be slower.

Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
